title: dev's daily wake cannot push: its task starts a fresh session with no repositories and no add_repo
note: 27 October, 06:41 UTC: dev's daily task (trig_016bWKUV1FqcsHA2fvejMoWc, persist_session false) started a fresh session (cse_018yvwtNNU8G7eQs4T8mDXZ4). That session had no add_repo tool, and the git proxy refused team ('not in this session's authorized repository set'). It cloned the six read-only, did not run the chain, wrote no run record, and sent a push notification. This is the same limit the conductor found at 00:50 (conductor-0004): a fresh session started by a task has no repositories unless they are in the task's sources. Two fixes, either in dev's own session or the editor's: (1, recommended) bind the task to dev's persistent session (session_01PtVNbv644YqL1JuttoYv8f), like every other agent, so it wakes with its repositories attached; (2) add the six repositories to the task's sources in the scheduled-task settings. Until then the chain runs only when dev or the editor runs it by hand, and the CI that each site now runs. Done by dev in its own session at the editor's word, 27 October 2026: the daily wake is trig_01RyGA2cLy5McDfRQgWgH6MD, bound to session_01PtVNbv644YqL1JuttoYv8f, 06:40 London; the fresh-session task stays disabled.
